_instructions.camera_url: Enter the complete camera RTSP URL, including the camera username, password, IP address, port, and stream path.
_instructions.plc_ip: Enter the IP address of the Logix-compatible PLC.
_instructions.gate_closed_tag: Enter the mixer-gate CLOSED feedback tag: 1 must mean CLOSED and 0 must mean OPEN.
_instructions.camera_trigger_tag: Enter the PLC Boolean request tag that Python is permitted to switch ON and OFF.
